kpi_specs.name: Total Revenue
kpi_specs.description: Sum of all transaction totals, representing the overall revenue generated from music sales.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT SUM("Total") AS total_revenue FROM data
kpi_specs.reasoning: Total revenue is a fundamental KPI for any retail business, providing a single summary metric of overall performance.

kpi_specs.name: Revenue by Country
kpi_specs.description: Sum of transaction totals grouped by billing country, identifying top revenue-generating markets.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT "BillingCountry", SUM("Total") AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY "BillingCountry" ORDER BY revenue DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: Revenue by country is critical for understanding geographic performance and is well-suited to a bar chart due to the low cardinality of countries.

kpi_specs.name: Monthly Revenue Trend
kpi_specs.description: Sum of transaction totals grouped by month, showing revenue trends over time.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "InvoiceDate") AS month, SUM("Total") AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
kpi_specs.reasoning: Tracking revenue over time is essential for identifying trends and seasonality, making a line chart the ideal visual.

kpi_specs.name: Average Purchase Value by Customer
kpi_specs.description: Average transaction total per customer, indicating customer spending behavior.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT "CustomerId", AVG("Total") AS avg_purchase_value FROM data GROUP BY "CustomerId" ORDER BY avg_purchase_value DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: This KPI provides insights into customer value and is best displayed as a table to show individual customer performance.

kpi_specs.name: Top Genres by Revenue
kpi_specs.description: Sum of transaction totals grouped by primary music genre, identifying the most popular genres.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT "primary_genre", SUM("Total") AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY "primary_genre" ORDER BY revenue DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: Understanding genre popularity is key for inventory and marketing strategies, and a bar chart effectively highlights genre performance.
